An administrator wants to see all content types consuming a specific reusable field schema
verify the exact labels/location/functionality in the xperience source code
draft a short release note and post it as part of the JIRA issue comment
also draft a short post to the training team about the feature
Navigation is confusing when trying to find schema usage.
